definitions.explanation: A small rural community or settlement, typically with a close-knit population engaged in agriculture. More formal and academic than {村|むら}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山間|さんかん}→山間：12589_sankan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{村落|そんらく}。
examples.english: A small village nestled in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{村落|そんらく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: This village has existed since the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、⟦{消滅|しょうめつ}→消滅：13331_shoumetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{村落|そんらく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of villages at risk of disappearing due to depopulation is increasing.

notes:
A formal, slightly literary or academic word for a village or rural settlement. Composed of {村|そん} (village) + {落|らく} (settlement, cluster). More commonly encountered in written Japanese, academic texts, and news reports than in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{農村|のうそん}→農村：04292_nouson⟧{村落|そんらく}: farming village
- ⟦{山間|さんかん}→山間：12589_sankan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{村落|そんらく}: mountain village
- {村落|そんらく}⟦{共同体|きょうどうたい}→共同体：11748_kyoudoutai⟧: village community
- {村落|そんらく}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: village society
- ⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧{村落|そんらく}: marginal village (at risk of disappearance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧: village — the everyday word; can also refer to an administrative unit. {村落|そんらく} is more formal and refers specifically to a physical settlement.
- ⟦{集落|しゅうらく}→集落：19622_shuuraku⟧: settlement; community — similar formality level; focuses on any grouping of residences, urban or rural. {村落|そんらく} specifically implies a rural village.
- {部落|ぶらく}: hamlet; settlement — historically neutral but now sensitive due to its association with the buraku discrimination issue. {村落|そんらく} carries no such connotation.
